name: Alpha IVF Group Berhad
overview: 今年公司的主要事项为股份从 ACE Market 转板至 Main Market，以及派发中期股息；公告中未披露任何业务板块的扩张、缩减、出售或新合约。
overview_en: The main corporate events this year were the transfer of the listing and quotation of the Company's shares from the ACE Market to the Main Market, and the declaration of interim dividends; no business segment expansion, reduction, disposal or new contract was disclosed in the announcements.

segments.name: 集团
segments.note: 今年公告主要涉及转板和股息派发，未披露各业务板块的具体动态。
segments.note_en: This year's announcements mainly relate to the transfer of listing and dividend payments, with no specific segment-level developments disclosed.

actions.title: Transfer of Listing
actions.text_en: Transfer of listing of the Company's shares.

actions.title: ALPHA - Notice of Book Closure
actions.text: 派发第一笔单层中期股息每股 0.25 sen。
actions.text_en: First single-tier interim dividend of 0.25 sen per ordinary share.

actions.title: ALPHA IVF GROUP BERHAD ("AIG" OR "THE COMPANY") PROPOSED AMENDMENTS TO THE CONSTITUTION OF AIG TO FACILITATE THE IMPLEMENTATION OF THE PROPO
actions.text: 以配合将公司全部已发行股本从 ACE Market 转板至 Bursa Malaysia Main Market。
actions.text_en: Proposed amendments to the Constitution to facilitate the transfer of the listing and quotation of the entire issued share capital from the ACE Market to the Main Market of Bursa Malaysia Securities.

actions.title: ALPHA - Notice of Book Closure
actions.text: 派发第二笔单层中期股息每股 0.6 sen。
actions.text_en: Second single-tier interim dividend of 0.6 sen per ordinary share.

actions.title: ALPHA - Notice of Book Closure
actions.text: 派发第一笔单层中期股息每股 0.5 sen。
actions.text_en: First single-tier interim dividend of 0.5 sen per ordinary share.
